subject: Boeing 747 jet
title: A Boeing 747 Is Made of 6 Million Parts. Half Just Hold It Together

scenes.text: Half of a jumbo jet is just the things holding it together.
A Boeing 747-400 is built from about six million parts.
Around three million of them are fasteners: rivets, bolts and screws.
Inside its walls run about 170 miles of electrical wiring.
Boeing built 1,574 of them, from the first flight in 1969 to the last delivery in 2023.
Six million parts, and every one of them has to hold at 35,000 feet.

description:
A Boeing 747-400 has about 6 million parts, roughly half of them fasteners, and about 171 miles (274 km) of wiring, according to Boeing.
The 747 first flew on 9 February 1969; Boeing built 1,574 of them before delivering the last one to Atlas Air on 31 January 2023.
Have you ever flown on a 747?
first_comment: Three million fasteners in one plane. What machine should we take apart next?
